summary: The power-thermal-charging group holds 21 files: 3 in product_a, 7 in system_a and 11 in vendor_a. It contains the Android charger-mode binary (AArch64 PIE) with its animation description and two PNG icons; HIDL thermal HAL 1.0 and 2.0 interface libraries in 32-bit and 64-bit system copies and 64-bit vendor copies (the system and vendor 64-bit copies differ only in build-id); the thermal helper library libthermalhalutils.so and its JSON sensor and cooling-device configuration, which the odm perf_service binary links and reads; two TOML power-hint configurations for the power HAL; a charger-class init module list run by init.insmod.sh; the battery-listener library loaded by dlopen from the audio HAL; the external battery client library linked by the health HAL implementation; and the IBatteryStats AIDL library linked by libsensorservice. The server processes for the thermal HAL (odm perf_service) and the external battery HAL (odm vendor.oculus.hardware.externalbattery@1.0-service) sit in odm_a and are outside this group. Deep-dive coverage: 13 items.

It is stripped, but its .gnu_debugdata section holds a compressed symbol table that defines the IExternalBattery proxy and stub classes and the hardware::oculus::health::ExternalBattery wrapper, so the binary contains its own compiled copy of that code rather than loading libexternalbattery.so at run time.
